data.title: Learning & Development Facilitator
data.description:
Overview

The Learning & Development Facilitator is a high-impact role with significant exposure across the firm. You’ll facilitate across a broad range of audiences, from summer interns and early-career employees to experienced managers and senior leaders. You’ll be equally comfortable leading a student program in the morning and facilitating a leadership development session in the afternoon, adapting your approach and presence to meet the needs of each audience. You can build a program from the ground up or quickly learn and deliver curriculum developed by someone else, making it relevant, engaging, and practical. Success in this role requires the credibility and confidence to engage smart, highly analytical audiences across technology, trading, and operations, including senior leaders who will ask challenging questions and expect thoughtful, practical answers.

This is a generalist L&D role that blends facilitation, instructional design, and program delivery, rather than a traditional client-facing L&D consulting position. You won’t own a dedicated business-group relationship. Instead, you’ll be a core member of the L&D team, collaborating closely with colleagues globally to deliver a shared internal curriculum. Some programs will be your own design, while others will be developed by colleagues or sourced externally, and you’ll be expected to deliver all of them with the same level of confidence and quality. You’ll also serve as the primary professional development point of contact for trading interns and junior traders, giving you an ongoing relationship with that population while continuing to support development across career stages, including management and leadership programming.

In this role, you will:

Facilitate Across a Wide Range of Audiences

  • Deliver engaging, high-quality facilitation across student and intern programs, early-career and professional development curricula, and management development sessions.
  • Confidently engage intelligent, opinionated participants across technical and business functions, responding effectively to challenging questions and adapting in the moment.
  • Build credibility and trust quickly with participants at every career stage and across departments.

Design and Develop Training Content

  • Design instructionally sound learning modules and training content for a fast-paced, dynamic organization where employees have limited time.
  • Develop practical, relevant content grounded in real business scenarios and evidence rather than generic theory.
  • Create facilitator guides, participant materials, activities, and assessments that support consistent, repeatable delivery.

Build eLearning and Blended Learning Solutions

  • Design and develop eLearning modules and other digital learning assets using standard authoring tools.
  • Blend live facilitation with self-paced and digital learning components to create cohesive learning experiences.
  • Maintain and refresh existing eLearning content as programs and business needs evolve.

Own Delivery of a Shared Internal Curriculum

  • Take ownership of internal training content, whether developed independently, created by L&D colleagues, or sourced externally.
  • Learn new content quickly and deliver it with the same confidence, command, and polish as content you have developed yourself.
  • Partner with L&D colleagues to continuously refine and improve programs based on participant feedback and outcomes.

Partner Across the Business and Global L&D Team

  • Build and maintain credibility across a range of departments, including technology, trading, and operations, developing enough understanding of each function to make learning relevant and practical.
  • Collaborate closely with L&D colleagues across regions to share content, coordinate delivery, and ensure programs remain aligned with global frameworks and standards.

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. We apply machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets to uncover actionable insights — and we expect the same standard of rigor from every function that supports our people.

 


What we're looking for

  • 6–8 years of experience in corporate training, facilitation, or Learning & Development. A formal instructional design certification is not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate confidently and effectively across diverse audiences, from interns and early-career employees to experienced professionals and managers.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the presence and credibility to engage participants with varied learning styles in a fast-paced environment.
  • A practical, analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose what a learning solution needs to accomplish rather than simply following a standard template.
  • Hands-on experience designing training content and applying sound instructional design practices.
  • Experience creating eLearning modules using authoring tools such as Articulate Rise or similar platforms, strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing or delivering scenario-based, experiential, and case study-based learning.
  • Ability to build credibility across diverse business functions, such as technology, trading, and operations.
  • Comfort both creating original content and learning and delivering curricula developed by others.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with a global L&D team, including sharing content and coordinating delivery across regions.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple programs, priorities, and audiences simultaneously.
  • A generalist mindset, energized by working across a variety of topics and audiences rather than supporting a single client group.

data.title: Employee Experience Manager
data.description:
Overview

We’re looking for an experienced Employee Experience Manager to lead the day-to-day workplace experience in our London office, creating a welcoming, well-run environment that makes employees’ working lives easier and more connected. You’ll serve as the central point of coordination for employee needs, partnering closely with Facilities, IT, Security, and vendors to deliver seamless services and support.

 

You’ll improve and standardize employee services, events and programming, establishing clear processes and consistently high standards. You’ll also partner with the Front Desk and its direct manager to support a welcoming professional experience for employees, candidates, and visitors.

 

What You'll Own

 

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Lead the delivery of Employee Experience across the London office, creating a welcoming, engaging and inclusive workplace.
  • Identify opportunities to continually enhance the employee experience through employee feedback, observation and stakeholder partnership.
  • Develop and deliver initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, using available data and feedback to reinforce Susquehanna's culture.
  • Manage and negotiate local employee perks and benefits providers, ensuring offerings stay competitive and relevant to the London office

Office Management

  • Partner with Facilities and internal stakeholders to ensure the London office provides a welcoming, professional and engaging environment for employees, candidates, clients and visitors.
  • Oversee the procurement and management of office supplies and workplace resources, ensuring the office is well-equipped and operates efficiently.
  • Support travel coordination for senior leaders, visitors and candidates where required.

Events & Programming

  • Oversees and creates elevated company events, team off-sites, milestone celebrations, employee perks and amenities, overseeing programming from concept through to final execution.
  • Develop sports and social programming through identifying interests, exploring local opportunities, and coordinating participation to build connections across the office.
  • Creating and maintaining the events calendar and analyze budget requirements.
  • Partner with leadership on all-hands meetings, exec visits, and other high-profile gatherings

Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with Employee Experience vendors, ensuring high standards of service delivery.
  • Monitor vendor performance, service levels and budgets, driving continuous improvement and value for the business.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the London Employee Experience team, creating a high-performing and customer-focused function.
  • Build strong partnerships across HR, Recruiting, Facilities and business teams to deliver a seamless employee experience.
  • Work closely with the EMEA Employee Experience team, collaborating with colleagues across London and Dublin to deliver a seamless and consistent employee experience across the region.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Maintain a dotted-line working relationship with the Facilities Manager, Food Program Manager, Front Desk and IT Manager to align on food program requirements, space planning, moves/adds/changes, equipment needs, and technology in shared spaces (conference rooms, AV, badge/access systems)
  • Act as an escalation point for office-related issues, resolving them quickly and calmly
  • Partner with regional and global Employee Experience and HR on initiatives, onboarding experience, benefits and employee engagement efforts
  • Partner with Recruiting, Hospitality, Facilities, and other teams to anticipate busy periods, including new hire and intern onboarding, recruiting activity, office moves, and overlapping events, and coordinate employee support, services, and resources to ensure a smooth, welcoming experience.

What we're looking for

  • 5–7+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, facilities coordination, or corporate events. Time spent managing people
  • You genuinely care about making the employee experience great
  • Previous people leadership experience, with a track record of leading, coaching and developing high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience managing external vendors and service providers, ensuring high standards of service delivery.
  • Strong commercial judgement, problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Experience planning and executing events at varying scale, from small team gatherings to large off-sites or all-hands
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and juggling competing priorities, especially during high-volume or fast-changing periods
  • Strong project management skills: you keep multiple workstreams moving without dropping details
  • Excellent communicator who can flex between vendors, senior leaders, IT/facilities partners, and employees at all levels
  • Experience working alongside or coordinating with IT and Facilities functions preferred
  • Calm under pressure, resourceful, and hands-on — willing to do the detailed work as well as set the strategy

data.title: Business Analytics AI Co-op with Drexel University
data.description:
Overview

The Susquehanna Co-op Program gives you an opportunity to apply what you learn in class to real world business scenarios. As an AI Co-op program for a hands-on, high-impact learning experience at the intersection of technology and data. In this role, you will work on real projects that have measurable business impact while receiving mentorship from experienced technologists and business analysts who will support your growth.

 

Susquehanna co-ops will gain a deep understanding of how large language models operate in real-world, data-driven environments. You will develop AI product thinking skills, including how to select impactful use cases and evaluate business value. You will also learn how to assess model quality, reliability, and risk using appropriate evaluation methods.


What we're looking for

  • Students pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Business Analytics or related field
  • Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, SQL, C# or similar)
  • Experience with NLP or working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and data modeling.
  • Curiosity, collaboration, and a desire to learn in a fast-paced environment
  • Interest in financial services industry is a plus.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Our non-hierarchical culture allows employees of every level to thrive and make impact. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development.

data.title: SGE Venture Capital / Growth Equity Co-op with Drexel University
data.description:
Overview

Susquehanna Growth Equity (SGE) is a leading growth equity firm focused on high growth software, internet and business services investments in the United States, Europe, and Israel. Since our founding in 2006, we have invested more than $4.5B in 100+ exciting companies around the world. We are focused on finding great companies, supporting their growth, and providing great returns for everyone involved.

 

As a Venture Capital / Private Equity co-op, you will work directly with our Business Development, Investment, and Value Creation teams in identifying, contacting, and evaluating potential companies for investment. This opportunity offers an introduction to venture capital and private equity investing within a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will quickly gain valuable, hands-on experience as you develop analytical skills, network with industry entrepreneurs, and evaluate potential companies in new industries for investment.

 

To learn more about SGE’s investment approach, team, and portfolio, visit www.sgep.com.

 

 Job duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Identifying and sourcing new investment opportunities
  • Performing thesis-based market research and industry analysis
  • Analyzing investment presentations / materials from potential investment targets
  • Participating in various due diligence items
  • Assisting in the M&A process for portfolio companies
  • Constructing presentation materials for the firm and its portfolio companies

 


What we're looking for

  • Outgoing personality and willingness to aggressively market the firm during phone calls and in-person meetings with entrepreneurs
  • Superior work ethic, strong desire to learn, and uncompromising attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive approach with the confidence and capability to act autonomously
  • Excellent analytical, research, and organizational skills
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills
  • Superb critical thinking ability and demonstrated leadership experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Impressive academic record
  • Visa sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position now or in the future

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

Susquehanna Financial Group (SFG) integrates expertise in trading, research, and sales to deliver value to institutional clients including mutual funds, hedge funds, and pension/endowment funds.

 

As a Derivatives Sales Trader Co-op, you will gain hands-on experience working on a trading desk while developing a deep understanding of financial markets, client engagement, and equity derivatives. You will collaborate closely with trading, strategy, market intelligence, and research teams to support client activity and generate market insights.

 

Job duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Assist sales traders in managing client relationships and responding to market inquiries
  • Collaborate with derivatives strategy and research teams on trade ideas and market analysis
  • Augment existing workflows to improve efficiency and better support institutional client needs
  • Build and maintain tools in Excel (and optionally Python/SQL) to support trading and automate reporting
  • Participate in desk discussions and real-time market decision-making

The ETF Sales & Trading Co-op is responsible for supporting the ETF Sales & Trading order handling team with their daily workflows, involving quote entry, post-trade processes, and data analysis. The Susquehanna ETF Sales & Trading Desk brings/directs order flow to our ETF traders / market makers and oversees the customer interaction / order handling / order execution.

 

As an ETF Sales & Trading Co-op, utilizing your technical and analytical skills, you will have daily tasks, projects, and responsibilities that directly impact the trading and operations of the desk, all the while gaining exposure to what the desk does and how it interacts / collaborates with our traders, customers, and operations associates.

data.description:
Overview

The Susquehanna Co-op Program gives you an opportunity to apply what you learn in class to real world business scenarios. As a Trade Operations co-op, you will work both individually and as part of a team in one of our trading, operations, or financial services groups. Co-op students are placed in teams based on their preferences, major, background and skills, and Susquehanna's most critical business needs.

 

Susquehanna co-ops are given the opportunity to participate in projects that will contribute directly to the various businesses that they support. Co-ops are immersed into specific teams and interact with senior staff members on a daily basis. Co-ops will gain insight into Susquehanna's business and its approach to decision making. 

Possible placements include:

  • Convertible Bonds – Bonds that can be converted into a predetermined amount of stock
  • Fixed Income – Products including bonds, futures, ETFs and OTC derivatives
  • Equity Options – The right to buy or sell an underlying security at a fixed price
  • Institutional Brokerage – The customer facing broker dealer arm of Susquehanna that trades on behalf of our institutional customers
  • ETFs – Collection of securities that track an index or other asset, which can be traded on an exchange like a regular stock
  • Stock Loan – Finance the firm's net equity positions through the process of borrowing and lending securities

Trade operations co-ops will have the opportunity to experience a dynamic trading environment. These co-ops are placed directly in front or mid office operations teams and are responsible for all aspects of trade blottering, settlement, and profit and loss calculations for the trading desks.


What we're looking for

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, specifically Excel and Access
  • Proficiency with Python, VBA and/or SQL a plus
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization and external vendors
  • Detail oriented; ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast paced environment
  • Must be a self-starter, a quick learner, and resourceful in solving problems
  • Previous experience in the financial services industry or completion of finance- or investment-related coursework a plus
  • Probability and Statistics background a plus
  • Must be available to complete the full duration of co-op and training week

 

What’s in it for you

  • Our non-hierarchical culture allows employees of every level to thrive and make impact. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development.

  • Relaxed dress code (jeans and sneakers are the norm and team jerseys every Friday)

  • Co-op classes designed to teach about Susquehanna’s business and encourage professional development

  • Fully stocked kitchens for breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages

  • A forty thousand square-foot state of the art fitness facility with brand-new equipment, multi-purpose courts, group exercise classes, and locker room spaces

  • Discounts for dining, entertainment, shopping, travel, and attractions

  • Social events such as a poker tournament, holiday party, company outings, and more

  • On-site Wellness Center

  • On-site services such as a mailroom, barber, dry cleaning, and car maintenance

  • Opportunities to give back to the community through Susquehanna sponsored events and donation drives

 

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

data.title: Technical Business Analyst Co-op with Drexel University
data.description:
Overview

The Susquehanna Co-op Program gives you an opportunity to apply what you learn in class to real world business scenarios. As a Technical Business Analyst Co-op, you are working right in the heart of Susquehanna’s business, working with a variety of departments across the globe. In this role, you may find yourself acting as the bridge between our operations teams and our development and technical teams, translating business requests into tools, systems, and/or reports that directly impact business operations. In addition, you could also be directly involved with the production and maintenance of daily, monthly, and annual reports used by the Managing Directors in various decision making processes for the firm. In this role, you will have the opportunity to truly get to know our business and understand that data and technology behind the work we do, all the while interacting with key members of our trading, operations, technology, and management teams.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Working between our Bala HQ and offices in Dublin and Sydney to support the development and implementation of universal calculations tools that are agnostic to location and
    securities type
  • Analyze business processes and workflows, noting areas where processes and controls can be improved or implemented to reduce/mitigate risk
  • Tests effectiveness of controls
  • Supporting the build-out of an internal system of books and records that incorporates counter-party data from varying trading systems and normalizes it for easier
    consumption
  • Managing an initiative to put in place reconciliation tools that facilitate data comparison and trade reporting
  • Ad-hoc projects as required

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience building solutions in relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL and/or MariaDB
  • Proficiency in one or more object-oriented programming languages -- most used languages include Python and VBA
  • Experience with HTML
  • Knowledge of SDLC models is a plus
  • Interest in the financial markets and building their functional and technical knowledge to support the needs of the business
  • Experience within a Trading Operations, Business Analyst, or related role is a plus

data.title: Risk and Controls Co-op with Drexel University
data.description:
Overview

Risk and Controls develops and maintains the firm's Enterprise Risk Management Strategy. The team identifies, monitors, evaluates, and manages both financial and non-financial risks, while also running day-to-day risk management activities, leading projects, and helping advance the risk program. As a critical function, Risk and Controls shapes how the firm manages risk and contributes to the continued strengthening of a robust risk management program.

 

Your Impact: 

On our Risk and Controls team, you will apply your analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate business processes and workflows, identify areas of risk and opportunities for improvement, document and test controls, and contribute to the firm's risk mitigation efforts. You will also support key functions such as entity onboarding and incident and issue management, collaborating with stakeholders across the firm while gaining exposure to the markets and other areas of the business.

 

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience in developing a risk management program, executing strategic projects, and engaging cross-functional stakeholders within a fast-paced, innovative financial institution.

  • Analyze business processes and workflows to identify risks and areas of improvement
  • Document and test controls for operational effectiveness
  • Support the entity onboarding process to the firm’s due diligence standard
  • Manage incidents and other risk events through detection, identification of root cause, and planning/tracking of remediation with cross functional stakeholders
  • Prepare and maintain high-quality risk management education materials for firmwide stakeholders
  • Assist with ad hoc projects to ensure timely delivery of initiatives

What we're looking for

  • Prior experience with VBA and SQL a plus
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization and external vendors
